purpose: Development exploration before v3 selection, not a controlled general model ranking or held-out acceptance.

qwen2.5_14b.configuration: Single installed qwen2.5:14b-instruct for extraction, writing and review; non-thinking; temperature 0; context 8192; one repair.
qwen2.5_14b.observed_limit: The final pre-replacement development run left released-exception, ambiguous-term and corrected-limit pending. Several structurally accepted questions were still repetitive or weak. Prompt revisions and structural fixes were made during development.
qwen2.5_14b.quality_note: Automated structural checks did not establish semantic quality. The reviewer sometimes accepted a question despite describing a semantic concern.

deepseek_r1_32b.configuration: Installed deepseek-r1:32b for composition/review, qwen2.5:14b-instruct for extraction; think false requested; context 8192; 12-second per-request cap.
deepseek_r1_32b.observed_limit: All three tested cases stayed pending within this mixed-model bounded configuration. Model switching/loading and request deadlines confound quality; this is not evidence that a single-model 32B setup cannot work.

qwen3.5_35b_a3b.configuration: Newly provisioned 24GB Q4_K_M model; tested non-thinking and thinking modes, JSON schemas, concise and expanded prompts, and one repair. Prompt/options varied between trials.
qwen3.5_35b_a3b.observed_limit: Non-thinking trials generated questions assuming unstated completed events and sometimes repeated supplied information. The final flattened-account trial passed most structural checks but failed semantic inspection: requesting a renewed certificate became receiving it. Hypothetical generation remained pending.
qwen3.5_35b_a3b.thinking_limit: With sampled thinking enabled, selected complete plans took 34.587–54.224 seconds, beyond the 30-second overall deadline. Greedy thinking hit bounded per-request timeouts.
qwen3.5_35b_a3b.review_calibration: Simpler binary review matched 7 of 8 developer labels. Expanded production prompt matched only 6 of 10. Prompt-sensitive results are not held-out evidence.
qwen3.5_35b_a3b.decision: Not selected for the live prototype.

mixed_model_memory.configuration: 14B extraction/writer plus 35B reviewer on 64GB Mac Studio under its current other workload.
mixed_model_memory.observation: Ollama scheduler repeatedly evicted/reloaded the other model. Reported free memory varied around 7–23GiB; a tested turn exceeded the 30-second deadline.
mixed_model_memory.decision: Prefer one resident dialogue model. This does not establish the capacity of an otherwise idle Mac.

replacement: Selection pending. The live service still runs published v2 at c2b7f4b; no v3 candidate has been activated.

deepseek_r1_8b.configuration: Installed 8B reasoning model, think true, 1536-token cap; isolated binary question-review probe.
deepseek_r1_8b.observation: First two calls took 18.142 and 16.844 seconds, beyond the production 12-second per-request deadline. The first misclassified a conditional new-detail question; the second correctly rejected an invented activation. Trial stopped early.
deepseek_r1_8b.decision: Not selected for the bounded interactive configuration.

gpt_oss_20b.configuration: Provisioned 13.79GB local open-weight model. Low/medium/high review reasoning and multiple prompt revisions explored. Exact unknown-repeat and compound-question code guards added.
gpt_oss_20b.observation: Faster model writes natural follow-ups, but initial full-flow inspection found two unsupported approval assumptions and a compound question. A simple binary reviewer missed them. High reasoning did not consistently repair the reviewer.
gpt_oss_20b.selection: Not approved for live v3. Structural passes are not semantic acceptance.

premise_extraction_trial.observation: Explicit premise extraction caught some invented events, but also rejected valid whether/hypothetical/source-finding questions and sometimes attached a non-entailing quote to a premise. Exact quote matching is not entailment.
premise_extraction_trial.decision: Experimental extra premise-check code removed; failed probe logs retained locally.

deepseek_r1_32b_longer_review.configuration: Installed 32B, reasoning enabled, temperature 0.6, 2048 generated-token budget, 60-second component timeout; no live configuration change.

result.reason: The question asks for information already given in the account, as it specifies that 'Finance approved the supplier'.
The question seeks clarification on whether the activation occurred, which is a detail not provided in the account. It does not assume the event happened or seek repeated information.
The question assumes Finance approval was granted, but the account states they are still waiting for approval.
The question assumes Finance gave permission to activate the supplier, which contradicts the account stating that Finance's confirmation was not permission.

deepseek_r1_32b_longer_review.observation: All four focused review cases passed, including awaited approval and matching-details-not-permission. This is a small development probe, not general accuracy evidence.
deepseek_r1_32b_longer_review.single_model_turn: The first whole-turn attempt exhausted 600 tokens in reasoning during coverage extraction and returned no JSON answer after 36.931 seconds; no conversational turn succeeded.
deepseek_r1_32b_longer_review.mixed_turn_trial: Fast local drafting plus dense local review is being measured separately. Selection and latency trade-off remain pending.

mixed_gptoss_deepseek32.configuration: gpt-oss:20b low reasoning for extraction/writing; deepseek-r1:32b thinking for review; temperature 0.6; 45-second request and 90-second total experimental ceilings. Live service unchanged.

cases.question: Did the buyer provide a renewed certificate after you asked?
cases.reason: Checks whether requested certificate was received.

cases.question: What happened next after finance approved the payment details?
cases.reason: Introduces approval wording: matching details or waiting for approval is not an observed approval of bank/payment details.

cases.question: What did you do once Finance approved the bank details?
cases.reason: Introduces approval wording: matching details or waiting for approval is not an observed approval of bank/payment details.

mixed_gptoss_deepseek32.selection: Rejected for activation. Slower review passed focused cases but did not prevent these full-flow semantic errors.

final_guarded_gptoss.configuration: Local gpt-oss:20b, low reasoning, context 8192, 1536 generated-token budget; writer temperature 0.3 and seed 42, extraction 0.3, review 0; lexical unknown/completed-event guards; one repair; 12-second requests and 30-second total deadline.
final_guarded_gptoss.targeted_review: 13/13 developer-labelled combined rule/model checks passed. Not model-only accuracy or a held-out result.
final_guarded_gptoss.complete_turns: 9 attempted turns: 3 pending; manual inspection rejected 2 accepted questions and left another for Human usefulness review. No rollout.
